remarks: Highly desirable Northstar mid-rise condo. w/lovely views of town! Bright & sunny, spacious 2 Bedrooms w/ sliders to the balcony, 2 Full Baths (tub and shower), Travertine stone floors and bathrooms, Granite counter tops & Granite vanity tops throughout, mosaic glass kitchen back splash, stainless steel kitchen w all appliances including microwave and dishwasher, kitchen peninsula with bar stool seating area, dining area and lovely living room with new "Desert Drift" pattern carpeting, brushed nickel lighting fixtures and hardware, WASHER/DRYER in unit, 1 reserved parking space w additional one avail. to lease for $75.00. One of the most desirable in town locations. One block to the University, cafes & restaurants, mall, shops, theaters, Mill River Park and train. Secure, gated entrance to the parking lot. No pets, non-smokers, please. Credit check and Move-in & move-out fees ($200 each), and are paid by tenant (s). Owner/Broker
